Economy · India

Indian Rupee Gains Slightly Against US Dollar

The Indian Rupee saw a marginal increase of 4 paise against the US dollar in early trade, reaching 94.39. This movement occurred while the dollar index, which measures the dollar's strength against six major currencies, was up by 0.01% at 99.18. The increase in the dollar index was attributed to safe-haven demand amid renewed tensions between the U.S. and Iran.
